verdict.rationale: dltHub supports delegating pipeline work to AI agents, but only through external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). Its AI Harness of skills, rules and MCP servers equips those agents, and onboarding 'launches your coding agent'. Marketing says 'agents doing the work on infra we run', but nothing shows an assistant built into the product itself, such as a chat or copilot in the app.dlthub.com Web UI. Missing for 10: a native built-in assistant inside the dlt/dltHub UI or CLI, documentation of in-product task delegation without bringing your own agent, and independent hands-on corroboration.
